setup.title: Suit Up
setup.style: Live-action, cinematic science fiction with practical-looking hardware, a night garage workshop full of robotic arms and soft blue holograms, a coastal city at dusk, the sky above the clouds, a hangar bay and a desert test range; one continuous shot per prompt.

cast.name: Kai
cast.description: Kai, an engineer in his thirties with short black hair, a trimmed beard and warm brown skin, wearing a charcoal-gray henley shirt with pushed-up sleeves and dark jeans.

extras.music: A driving electronic orchestral score with deep synth pulses and soaring strings, kept below the sound effects.
extras.voice: Kai, speaking in voice-over, a man in his thirties with a calm, low and confident voice and a neutral American accent (S1),

shots.prompt: A wide shot of a garage workshop at night, where Kai stands at a workbench under a floating blue hologram. Kai, an engineer in his thirties with short black hair and a trimmed beard, in a charcoal-gray henley and dark jeans, sketches the outline of a sleek armored suit on a glowing tablet. The blue hologram above the bench turns slowly, showing the suit's white-and-teal plates. Behind him an empty suit platform waits under a ring of robotic arms. The camera holds a wide shot of the whole workshop with Kai small at the bench.

The blue hologram above the bench turns slowly, showing the suit's white-and-teal plates. Behind him an empty suit platform waits under a ring of robotic arms. Kai, speaking in voice-over, a man in his thirties with a calm, low and confident voice and a neutral American accent (S1), says: <d>[English] Tonight we find out if it actually fits.</d> After this line the voice-over stays silent for the rest of the shot.

shots.prompt: A close-up of the workbench under a magnifying lamp, where Kai fits a power core into a white chest plate. Kai, an engineer in his thirties with short black hair and a trimmed beard, in a charcoal-gray henley and dark jeans, lowers a small hexagonal power core into the center of a sleek white chest plate with teal trim lying on the bench. He turns a tiny screwdriver, and the hexagon flickers, then glows a steady cyan, lighting his face from below. The camera holds a tight close-up on his hands and the chest plate, then tilts up to his face.
